title: Josiah Finds God's Word
summary: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 2 Kings 22:1-13 and look for how this passage teaches: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.

tell_it: King Josiah heard the Book of the Law and was sorry for Israel's sin. He wanted the people to listen to God.
understand_it: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Josiah Finds God's Word reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. God's Word matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Josiah Finds God's Word shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
teen_explanation: Josiah Finds God's Word gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
God's Word teaches truth and calls for response.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when god's word is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Josiah hear read?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The Book of the Law. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 2 Kings 22:11 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Josiah Finds God's Word?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Word Discovery
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Josiah Finds God's Word. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
